In March, DML working group members travelled to Frankfurt to attend the [FAIRagro Community Summit](https://fairagro.net/en/event/summit-2026/). The event brought together the FAIRagro community to showcase the services and tools the consortium has been developing to advance Open and FAIR data practices in agricultural research.

[FAIRagro](https://fairagro.net/en/) is an NFDI consortium that has represented the agrosystems research community in Germany since 2023. With more than 30 partners, it is building a FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) research data management infrastructure — developing the tools and workflows needed to support Open Science and sustainable crop production.

The summit was a great opportunity to exchange ideas, hear about ongoing developments, and connect with others working on research data challenges in agriculture. We look forward to future collaboration with the FAIRagro consortium!
